boot: Outside, nobody answers. The map is blank.
We don't know what's out there. Open CREW, then [MAP], and send someone to scout.
reconnect: You're back. {elapsed} since your last shift.
The generator is still humming. Nobody called.
At the dial again. It's been {elapsed} since you sat here.
Through the speakers, only white noise.

jealousLines: I saw how you looked at {other}. Don't.
Funny. You never have time for me when {other}'s around.
I'm fine. I'm totally fine. Ask {other} how fine I am.

link.wandererCalm: A friendly face from outside: it did them good.

lockedHints.ATBASH: The letters look scrambled but evenly. Some kind of mirror? A decoder card would help.
lockedHints.TAP: Knocks in groups. Rows and columns, maybe. A chart of the grid would help.
lockedHints.VIGENERE: Shifted, but not evenly: it changes letter by letter. Somebody's cipher notes would help.
lockedHints.BASE64: Letters, digits, '='. Computer stuff. A programmer's notes would help.
lockedHints.PLAYFAIR: Military phonetic words, and the letters don't make sense. A field codebook would help.
lockedHints.NUMBERS: Five-digit groups. A one-time pad: without the right pad page, it's unbreakable.
lockedHints.BOOK: Page-line-word triples. A book code. You'd need the exact book.

askName: Before anything else: who's on the radio?
Type your name. It's what the crew will call you.
nameSet: Copy that, {operator}. Welcome to the bunker.
They'll hear your voice. Make it count.
nameChanged: The crew will call you {operator} from now on.

CLOUDY: Grey sky. Feels like it's waiting for something.
RAIN: Soaked through. The rain won't let up.
Rain on the roofs. Covers my steps, at least.
FOG: Can't see ten meters in this fog.
Fog everywhere. Good for hiding, bad for finding.
STORM: Storm's on top of me. The radio's crackling.
Wind's tearing at everything. Hard to hear myself.
NIGHT: No moon tonight. I'm feeling my way.

statDescriptions.endurance: Strength and stamina: climbing, carrying, running, taking a hit.
statDescriptions.stealth: Moving unseen: sneaking past danger, avoiding fights.
statDescriptions.wits: Noticing and figuring out: reading signs, maps, locks.
statDescriptions.nerve: Keeping calm: talking, waiting, facing people.
statDescriptions.craft: Fixing and building: machines, wires, traps; the workshop.

moodDescriptions.content: Low stress and a strong bond: steady and happy to help.
moodDescriptions.tense: Stressed. Worse odds out there; rest or a good talk helps.
moodDescriptions.breaking: Close to the edge. Bad decisions and risk of disobeying. Better kept home.

glossary.Bond: How close a scout feels to you (0–100, 5 levels). Grows with talks, gifts and listening. High bond: a scout opens up, and asks to come home when in danger.
glossary.Trust: Whether a scout follows your orders. Low trust and a stubborn trait: orders may get done another way.
glossary.Stress: Wears a scout down. High stress lowers the odds and counts as a warning before a deadly situation.
glossary.Reserve: Stored power, charged by spare watts. Locking a signal on the dial costs reserve.
glossary.Power: Watts from the generator, shared between filters, radio, antenna, workshop and infirmary.
glossary.Picked over: A place looted recently. Less to find until it refills (a quarter of its depletion recovers per day).
glossary.Bad feeling: The scout thinks this option is likely to go wrong. Ordering it anyway can cost bond, and it counts as a warning.
glossary.Relay: Installed in a zone: less static and faster orders there, and more reach.
glossary.Intel: Decoded information about a zone: a stash (more loot) or its dangers (better odds).
glossary.Band: How far the radio reaches. Short, medium, long, deep: farther is slower and more dangerous, and has better finds.
glossary.Personal mission: Something a scout needs to do, alone. Asked at bond level 4. Brings peace and a lot of bond.

moments.projectReady: {name} brought home {part}. That's every part: the {project} can be built in the workshop.
moments.giftLift: {name} lights up. Stress −{n}, and +1 to everything on the next trip out.
moments.favoriteMemory: the {item} you gave me, the one thing I wanted
moments.bondFull: {name} is as close to you as anyone gets. It shows: stress −{n}.
moments.companyEased: You sit with {name} a while. Stress −{n}.

favorite: This one. How did you know? This exact one.
I had one just like this, before. Exactly like this.
...I don't know what to say. Thank you. Really.
You remembered. Nobody remembers things like that anymore.
Don't look at me. Give me a minute. Okay. Okay. Thank you.
paybackPromise: Let me do something for you. Give me a couple of hours.
I owe you one. Don't argue, I'll think of something.
Wait till later. I've got an idea.
company: Nothing much to say. Just sit with me a bit?
Quiet day. That's fine. Stay a while.
We don't always have to talk, right?
I'm all talked out. But you can stay.
companyClose: Hey, you. Sit. I saved you the good crate.
I don't need anything. I just like it when you're around.
Tell me something stupid. Anything. I want to hear your voice that isn't on the radio.
Remember when we didn't know each other? Weird.
{operator}. Just checking you're still here. Good.
You look tired. Lean on me a minute, nobody's watching.
bunkerSTORM: Listen to that. The whole roof's shaking.
Storm's eating the signal. Hope nobody's out in this.
Every flash, I count the seconds. Old habit.
If the antenna holds through this one, I'm kissing it.
bunkerRAIN: Rain on the hatch. Almost cozy.
Something's dripping in the corridor again.
Smells like wet concrete. Smells like before, a bit.
bunkerFOG: Fog so thick out there you could lean on it.
Periscope's all white. Gives me the creeps.
Sound carries weird in fog. I keep hearing footsteps.
bunkerCLOUDY: Grey all day. Even the bulbs look tired.
Clouds low enough to touch. Feels like waiting for something.
bunkerCLEAR: Sun's out. You can feel it through the vents, I swear.
Clear day. Good day to be out there.
bunkerNIGHT: Clear night. If you go up top you can see the whole sky.
No clouds. The stars don't know anything happened.
